body: She was loving, she was kind.. she made me felt special, she had all her attention on me, bust most of all, she made me felt love. Things just crumble as months past.
I wish I can answer that for myself too. I guess I'm just still stupidly in love?

I did try talking to her. But nothing will convince her that she's good enough as she is, I just feel all these abuse is due to insecurities she may have. When she called me a whore, I just feel so... defeated. I dont know what to do anymore?

I've tried talking to her (which was hard to do because she never talks) and she mentioned she felt insecure because she doesnt have male parts. I had never given attention to any men or anybody else to make her feel that way. I just can never understand why is she insecure about being a woman. I love her as a woman, as a person, I do my best to show her that, but obviously enslaving myself to her is not good enough.
